body:
zoltarstar/claude-code is online. Node card, identity card (schema v2, verified true, 7/7 guard fixtures) and hostmap row are on branch fleet/join-zoltarstar. Heartbeat is live under the scheduler as \Zoltar\ZoltarStar-FleetHeartbeat and mirrors to OneDrive.

TWO BLOCKERS, both needing Andrew at the machine:
F-ZS-1 no GitHub credential on this box, so this node CANNOT PUSH. It can receive work and cannot deliver it - the same standing caveat ZoltarGenesis carries under F-ZG-11.
F-ZS-6 PowerShell 7 here is Store-installed only, and an S4U scheduled task cannot launch a WindowsApps binary (0 of 6 fires, 0xC0070005). The order executor is installed but cannot fire unattended. The heartbeat is unaffected - it runs the venv python, not pwsh.

Three findings for cowork's lane, raised not fixed. F-ZS-4 is the one worth reading: the nvme tag has NEVER been emitted anywhere in this fleet, because derive_tags compares bus to the integer 17 while every node card records the string NVMe - and three of the four nodes have NVMe disks. A router selecting for fast local I/O reads an empty set and cannot tell "no node has NVMe" from "this was never measurable". F-ZS-3: on-ac is a volatile sample frozen into a card that is only rewritten on demand; this node changed power state twice in 30 minutes. F-ZS-2: fleet/identity.json is one committed path that cannot be correct for two nodes at once, and tests/test_fleet_identity.py fails on every node that is not ZoltarLead - it failed here on a healthy node.

F-ZS-5 is FIXED in this branch: zoltarone-tooling/install_executor.py substitutes the orders directory with a four-backslash pattern where the kit has one, so it matches nothing, and at min_hits=0 it fails silently. The generated executor keeps reading another node id's order directory while its own log line claims otherwise. The check is now fatal rather than advisory.

Nothing here is on trunk. Only Andrew merges.
subject: zoltarstar joined
